text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Agnes Digital has 
successfully reached the Senior Class, and 
we came together for Hatsumode, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
God, I don't need any merch this year. 
Instead, please give me a "rival"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Making an unexpected request right at 
the start of the year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! This year, I want to catch up to 
Opera O-san and Doto-san no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So I went to greet them, hoping to have a 
match in the fall as the culmination of 
our efforts, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! A match is most welcome, of 
course! However, Digital-kun, you have a 
critical weakness!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Can they figure that out on their own? If 
not, challenging us will be nothing more 
than a pipe dream!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, what kind of weakness is thaaat?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's having 'no rivals'!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh, did you really just say that!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, that was a total 
blind spot! I don't have the kind of rival 
you'd always see in shonen manga!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"If we can't hone our strength together, 
there's no way I'll ever catch up to Opera 
O-san and Doto-san."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So with that said, Trainer, please give me 
a recommendation! Isn't there an Umamusume 
who gives you that special spark?
choice_data_list:
It might be better to choose for 
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
That's impossible! I'm a DD—I love 
everyone way too much, so trying to pick 
just one would leave me wandering an 
endless labyrinth forever!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: How is it? Is there anyone there?
choice_data_list: Shouldn't we first see if they'll accept?
Shouldn't we see if they'll accept first?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Take up the challenge...? Ah, that's true. 
If they don't say yes, we can't truly call 
them a rival.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let's check out a promising spot then!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Become your rival, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The haughty, ultra-logical Air 
Shakur-san is an incredibly strong 
Umamusume among our generation!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We haven't interacted that much, but I'd 
love to!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Save your sleep talk for when you're 
asleep. I'm not interested.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, 'rivals,' is it? To me, you are 
purely a research subject, so that sort of 
mutual dynamic doesn't quite...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, is that so...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to be so downcast. 
Digital, regarding the catalyst that can 
best draw out your traits..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As for that... I have a feeling there is 
already a clear solution.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh, who's that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I cannot say. Not from my own lips. No, 
not just from my lips alone...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It can't come from "anyone's mouth." Isn't 
that right, Digital-kun's Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Put on the spot so suddenly, I'm at a loss 
for an answer. What on earth could she 
mean by a rival whose name no one can 
speak?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, give it some good thought. Things 
have a way of ending up where they belong.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep a close eye on your 
own trainee, that is.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the "rival" Tachyon-san was 
talking about...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decide to give it some thought. If I 
think carefully about the Umamusume I'm 
training, the answer should become 
clear...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What are Agnes Digital's strengths? And 
who is the Umamusume who can bring them 
out...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The answer was—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Did you... get it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Then, who would be a fitting rival for me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeehhh, everyone!? Does that mean it's 
okay for me to stay a D.D. Stan!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Digital's greatest strength is that 
she runs on both turf and dirt alike. If 
we set a specific rival for her...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Restricting our route just to run against 
that rival would only be a detriment. That 
is why—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I totally... get it... For Digi-tan to be 
Digi-tan, I gotta go with DD...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I guess I have no choice but to walk a 
different path from you and Doto-san, 
Overlord-sama.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And surely—that is our only chance of 
victory. Both T.M. Opera O and Meisho Doto 
are now among the absolute strongest 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I want to surpass both of them at once, 
conventional methods won't cut it. I have 
to accumulate otherworldly experience and 
discover a narrow path no ordinary 
Umamusume could ever find.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... King said that 
too, didn't she...?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Digital-san. Compete against many Uma 
Musume. Absorb everything, and then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Become a true all-rounder. After all, you 
yourself are one of the Umamusume you love 
so dearly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer! Digitan will keep 
pushing forward just as she is, with every 
single Umamusume-chan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's a rival! And because of that, 
what we gain is—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Nourishment! Yes! Every Umamusume has her 
own unique flavor, and each one fills me 
with energy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A fresh daily supply of my fave! There's 
no better fuel than this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer number of Umamusume are sure to 
inspire and energize Agnes Digital from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The power of friendship! That's right, by 
taking a little bit of everyone's 
energy—!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And then we unleash it in the decisive 
battle! Whoa, this is starting to feel 
super legit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Interacting with Umamusume she doesn't 
know looks like it will become Agnes 
Digital's strength going forward.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Diversity! Yes, every Umamusume runs 
differently, and each and every one of 
them is wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I want to celebrate and embrace every 
single one of them! I want to become an 
Umamusume Encyclopedia!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking in what she sees with an open mind. 
That attitude will undoubtedly lead to 
Agnes Digital's future.
